This may explain why spices are more commonly used in warmer climates, which have more infectious diseases, and why the use of spices is proeminent in meat, which is particularly susceptible to spoiling.  Spices are sometimes used in medicine, religious rituals, cosmetics or perfume production, or as a vegetable.
